userStories.title: Limit failed-transcript retention to failure archives
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Make the shared file transcript store's failure retention bound only kept-on-failure archives without evicting live sessions.

**Motivation** — With 51 live documents and no archives, one failed resume deleted an older chat's document; that chat's next open found `null` and silently created a fresh backend session.

**Approach** — Target: `pruneRetainedTranscripts(dir, maxRetained = MAX_RETAINED_TRANSCRIPTS, opts?: { readonly archivesOnly?: boolean }): Promise<number>`. With `archivesOnly: true` only names containing `.transcript.failed-` and ending `.json` are counted and deleted; live documents are never touched. Without the option the behaviour is unchanged.

Target: `retainTranscript(dir, id)` then `pruneRetainedTranscripts(dir, MAX_RETAINED_TRANSCRIPTS, { archivesOnly: true })`. The doc comments that describe the old prune (`transcript-store.ts` above `createFileTranscriptStore` and above `pruneRetainedTranscripts`, and `closeNativeSession` in `packages/nax-agent/src/native/session/session.ts`) are updated to say `retainFailed` bounds only the kept-on-failure archives and live names are bounded by the feature-startup sweep.

Symbols this feature only reads: `retainTranscript(dir, sessionName)` (renames `<name>.transcript.json` to `<name>.transcript.failed-<stamp>.json` and moves the `.images` sidecar with it), `deleteTranscriptFile(path)`, `MAX_RETAINED_TRANSCRIPTS`. `sweepFeatureTranscripts`, which calls `pruneRetainedTranscripts` without options and must keep pruning live names.

Failure handling: Pruning finds fewer archives than the cap: Nothing is deleted; returns 0.

Setup for the retainFailed ACs: mtimes are set explicitly with `utimes`, as `transcript-store.test.ts` does. In the 50-archive ACs the 50 archives get distinct mtimes, the other live document is older than every archive, and the document being retained is newer than every archive.

Add `packages/nax-agent/test/unit/native/transcript-store-archives-only.test.ts` — archives-only prune tests, kept apart so `transcript-store.test.ts` (559 lines) stays under the 650-line split threshold. Existing prune tests call `pruneRetainedTranscripts` without the option, whose behaviour is unchanged, and the existing `retainFailed` tests hold a single document. US-001 changes the behaviour of the exported `createFileTranscriptStore(...).retainFailed`; US-002 reaches it through `openChatSession`, the production entry point, with the real `createFileTranscriptStore` in `_openChatSessionDeps`, so a store that still prunes live names fails US-002's ACs.

**Scope** — In: optional archives-only filtering, retainFailed wiring, specified production comments, and new focused store tests. Out: the ACP chat entry-point regression belongs to US-002; all log-tail/panel changes belong to US-003. `sweepFeatureTranscripts` keeps pruning live and archived names together at feature startup; its contract is unchanged. Archives already pruned by an earlier `retainFailed` are not recovered, and live documents deleted by an earlier failed resume are not recreated. Do not modify retention rename/sidecar helpers or existing test files.

**Interface** — `pruneRetainedTranscripts(dir, maxRetained = MAX_RETAINED_TRANSCRIPTS, opts?: { readonly archivesOnly?: boolean }): Promise<number>`. The existing exported function retains its typed `dir: string` and default numeric cap; the third argument is optional. `createFileTranscriptStore(dir).retainFailed` continues returning `Promise<void>` through the unchanged TranscriptStore contract.

userStories.title: Protect other ACP chats when one resume falls back
userStories.description:
**Goal** — Add the binding real-file-store openChatSession regression proving that another chat remains resumable after one failed ACP resume.

**Motivation** — `openAcpBrain` (`packages/nax/src/chat/open-chat-session.ts`) builds one store per agent over `<sessions>/acp-<agent>`, a directory every chat on that agent shares, and calls `retainFailed` when a resume fails with an unusable-session error.

**Approach** — Adds an `openChatSession` regression over a real file store showing that an older chat's backend document and image sidecar survive another chat's failed resume. No production code in `packages/nax` changes.

`packages/nax/src/chat/open-chat-session.ts`: `openAcpBrain` — `store.load`, `deps.resumeAgentSession`, `isFreshFallback`, `store.retainFailed`, `deps.createAgentSession`. Unchanged.

US-001 changes the behaviour of the exported `createFileTranscriptStore(...).retainFailed`; US-002 reaches it through `openChatSession`, the production entry point, with the real `createFileTranscriptStore` in `_openChatSessionDeps`, so a store that still prunes live names fails US-002's ACs.

Setup: `openChatSession` with `_openChatSessionDeps.createFileTranscriptStore` left as the real `createFileTranscriptStore`, `_acpSessionDeps.acpBackend` stubbed as in `open-chat-session-acp.test.ts`, `createAgentSession` stubbed to return a fake session, and `resumeAgentSession` stubbed keyed on the session id: it rejects with a `NaxError` coded `AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND` for `Y` and resolves a fake session for `X`. Chats `X` and `Y` each have their own `storage.writeMeta` record with an `acp:codex` model. The directory `acpTranscriptDir(storage.dir, "codex")` holds 51 live documents, including `X` and `Y`, each with an ended turn marker; mtimes are set with `utimes` so `X`'s document is the oldest, and `X` also has a `.transcript.images` sidecar. Chat `Y` is opened with `resumeId` `Y`.

Add `packages/nax/test/unit/chat/open-chat-session-acp-shared-store.test.ts` — the real-file-store failed-resume regression. The story adds a test file only. Mirror the backend stub, open/release helper, metadata fixture, and dependency restoration patterns from the context files without replacing the real store. Capture resume/create counts after Y's open, then open X and verify the resumed id and unchanged creation count. Demonstrate the regression fails with the pre-US-001 store behavior; an upstream fix making it green is not a reason to omit the baseline demonstration.

**Scope** — In: one new test file exercising real files through the existing production entry point and keyed agent-session mocks. Out: production retention changes belong to US-001; production job-tail/panel changes belong to US-003. No production code in `packages/nax` changes. Archives already pruned by an earlier `retainFailed` are not recovered, and live documents deleted by an earlier failed resume are not recreated.

**Interface** — No production signature changes. Exercise `openChatSession`, `_openChatSessionDeps.createFileTranscriptStore`, `_acpSessionDeps.acpBackend`, `acpTranscriptDir(storage.dir, "codex")`, and `ACP_FRESH_SESSION_NOTICE("Codex")` through their existing contracts.
acceptanceCriteria: [integration] Given the real shared-store fixture with 51 live ended-turn documents, X oldest with an image sidecar, and Y's resume rejecting with NaxError code AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND, when openChatSession for Y with resumeId Y resolves, createFileTranscriptStore(dir).load("X") returns a document with a turn marker.

[integration] Given the real shared-store setup (51 live ended-turn documents, X oldest with an image sidecar, Y's resume rejecting with NaxError code AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND), when Y's open resolves, X's .transcript.images sidecar still exists.

[integration] Given that Y's open has resolved and the resumeAgentSession/createAgentSession mock call counts have been noted, when a later openChatSession for X with resumeId X resolves, resumeAgentSession is called with session id X, leaving the createAgentSession call count unchanged (only Y's call).

[integration; control] Given the real shared-store setup (51 live ended-turn documents, X oldest with an image sidecar, Y's resume rejecting with NaxError code AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND), when Y's open resolves, createAgentSession has been called once for Y's fallback.

[integration; control] Given the real shared-store setup (51 live ended-turn documents, X oldest with an image sidecar, Y's resume rejecting with NaxError code AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND), when Y's open resolves, Y's handle carries ACP_FRESH_SESSION_NOTICE("Codex").

routing.reasoning: The spec explicitly binds this test-only story separately: it integrates real shared transcript files, metadata, session locks and keyed ACP resume stubs through openChatSession without production edits. Sessions mandate three-session-tdd; verify baseline failure against the old store despite the upstream dependency already containing its fix.

analysis:
This is a focused bug fix in an existing Bun/TypeScript workspace, not a new subsystem. Direct reads and text searches were used because codebase-memory MCP is unavailable in this session. The binding decomposition is US-001 in packages/nax-agent, US-002 in packages/nax dependent on US-001, and independent US-003 in packages/nax. US-002 intentionally remains a test-only story under the binding exception; do not merge it into the store fix.

Transcript eviction: packages/nax-agent/src/native/session/transcript-store.ts:85 constructs the file store; retainFailed currently renames and calls the unqualified prune at lines 89-91. pruneRetainedTranscripts at line 212 selects every name containing .transcript. and ending .json at line 227, counts that combined population, sorts by mtime, and deletes the excess through deleteTranscriptFile at line 240. That helper at line 167 deletes JSON and its image sidecar together, explaining why both resumability and images disappear for an unrelated oldest live session. MAX_RETAINED_TRANSCRIPTS is 50 at line 183. retainTranscript at line 136 already moves JSON and its .images sidecar together and rolls JSON back if sidecar renaming fails; neither it nor deletion should be changed. The fix is an optional archivesOnly filter, used only by retainFailed, not a global narrowing of default pruning. Missing directories already return 0. Keep mtime ordering, count return, one-shot warning, and paired deletion behavior. Update the explanatory comments above createFileTranscriptStore and pruneRetainedTranscripts and at packages/nax-agent/src/native/session/session.ts:369, where closeNativeSession still describes the combined-directory cap. These are production changes required by Design even though the spec's Modifies/US-001 section says None; that section discusses existing test modifications, not an instruction to omit the production fix.

Compatibility and consumers: packages/nax/src/session/transcript-sweep.ts:35-38 calls pruneRetainedTranscripts(dir) at feature startup and must continue counting live and failed names together. packages/nax-agent/src/native/session/transcript-archive.ts:51 also uses the default pruning on separate redacted audit archives, whose names need not contain failed-; leave this consumer unchanged. The symbol is already public at packages/nax-agent/src/index.ts:194 and named in api/nax-agent.api.txt:493; this adds an optional argument without changing export names or requiring a data-format migration. Do not add another public seam or dependency. packages/nax-agent-acp/src/server/main.ts:124 constructs a shared file store and inherits the corrected retainFailed behavior with no server changes. nax-agent shipped source must remain Node-compatible and use its existing #src imports; nax uses Bun-native I/O. Releases are lockstep and not part of this feature.

Store tests: packages/nax-agent/test/unit/native/transcript-store.test.ts:43-57 demonstrates saving real images and checking sidecar names, line 226 demonstrates explicit utimes, line 312 pins oldest-first ordering, and line 508 tests retention with archives but only one live document. Existing default-prune tests must remain untouched and green. The 559-line file should not grow; create transcript-store-archives-only.test.ts for the mixed-population cases. Use real files, explicit distinct mtimes, and saveTranscript/retainTranscript rather than wall-clock sleeps. In the 50-archive/two-live fixture the unrelated live document must be older than every archive and the newly retained document newer than every archive, otherwise an incorrect combined cap can appear to pass. The cap and preserved-live assertions need independent checks.

ACP integration: packages/nax/src/chat/open-chat-session.ts:248-285 opens a real per-agent store under acpTranscriptDir, loads the backend document, resumes only when it has a turn marker, and retains on recognized unusable-session errors before creating a fresh session. The store is constructed at line 253 and retainFailed is reached at line 280. packages/nax/src/chat/acp/acp-session-options.ts:35-44 recognizes NaxError codes, including AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND; acpTranscriptDir at line 50 places all chats for one agent in the same acp-<agent> directory. openChatSession at packages/nax/src/chat/open-chat-session.ts:361 also manages a distinct native-history store and per-chat lock. The regression must call this production entry point with real storage and real createFileTranscriptStore, not a fake store that masks eviction. Existing open-chat-session-acp.test.ts:164 and :309 supply the resume-failure/backend-stub pattern, but its fake directory store cannot reproduce this bug. open-chat-session-acp-zero-turn.test.ts:71-87 and :175-184 provide real-store setup precedents; the new regression must leave createFileTranscriptStore fully real rather than copying its recording wrapper. Seed 51 live backend documents with ended turn markers, X oldest with a real saved image sidecar, distinct metadata for X/Y, and keyed resume stubs. After Y falls back, opening X must resume X without a second create; also pin Y's existing fresh-session notice. Release handles, restore _acpSessionDeps, and clean temporary directories. No production code or existing tests in nax change for US-002. Both session stories use three-session-tdd under the sessions security override; prove their non-control assertions fail with the original pruning behavior, including replaying the integration regression against the old store even though US-001 precedes US-002. Controls are explicitly expected to pass on the baseline.

Log tail: packages/nax/src/chat/jobs/job-runner.ts:53 declares ChatJobs.logTail; _jobRunnerDeps.readLog at line 99 uses Bun.file(path).text(). DetachedJobs.logTail at line 533 currently rejects invalid limits, reads the entire file, ignores one terminal line break, splits CRLF/LF, and slices the last floored N raw lines. Replace only the log reader seam and delegation, not lifecycle/spawn/attachment logic. Add packages/nax/src/chat/jobs/log-tail.ts with exported readTailLines, LOG_TAIL_CHUNK_BYTES=64*1024, and _logTailDeps.size/readRange; use Bun.file size and sliced arrayBuffer reads behind these seams. Split byte ranges on a local NEWLINE_BYTE=10 before decoding, carry the incomplete leading piece across reverse chunks, and ignore exactly one trailing line break rather than all trailing blank lines. Stop once the requested complete qualifying lines are available, including their preceding newline boundary, or at offset zero. The UTF-8 and long-line cases require accumulating the whole incomplete line before decoding. With nonEmpty the filter uses trimmed text only as a predicate; preserve original whitespace except trailing CR removal. Raw callers still see blank lines. Missing files return empty text whether size is zero or size/readRange throws ENOENT. All other size/readRange errors propagate unchanged out of logTail. This is chunk-bounded I/O, not a universal byte cap: sparse informative output and very long lines may require scanning the entire file, intentionally. Risks are off-by-one newline handling, reversing line order, incorrect CRLF removal, UTF-8 corruption at a chunk boundary, and accidentally suppressing EACCES. Avoid assertions based merely on elapsed time; count actual returned bytes through readRange for the 16 MiB fixture.

Panel wiring and other callers: packages/nax/src/chat/jobs/job-panel-view.ts:17 fixes the panel to 12 lines. logLinesOf at line 105 already trims, removes blanks, and keeps the last 12; leave it unchanged. logTailSource at line 174 must pass { nonEmpty: true } and retain its fail-soft catch; readJobPanelView at line 187 must be exercised with a real runner. packages/nax/src/chat/jobs/jobs-provider.ts:132 and packages/nax/src/tui/chat/useChatPicker.ts:87 omit the new option and must retain raw-line behavior. packages/nax/src/tui/chat/use-job-panels.ts:33/:170 sets the 2000 ms refresh cadence, which is unchanged. packages/nax/src/chat/background/task-registry.ts:59-69 is a useful byte/newline boundary example, not a shared reader to modify or reuse, because it has a different byte-cap contract. Existing job-runner-attach.test.ts:211-226 attaches real records and tests explicit/default line limits and missing/unknown logs. Create log-tail.test.ts for direct reader cases and job-runner-log-tail.test.ts for actual createJobRunner attachment and panel/error integration; restore seams and dispose runners/fake timers. Update only the existing exact-call assertion at job-panel-view.test.ts:426 to include the third argument. Typed mocks accepting fewer optional arguments remain compatible; jobs-provider.test.ts:161 intentionally retains its two-argument assertion.

Implementation and migration: read docs/architecture/ARCHITECTURE.md and applicable package/rules before implementation, use _deps seams rather than global monkey-patching, and keep new files within size limits. No new dependencies, configuration, on-disk schema, refresh interval, backend routing, or restoration of already deleted documents are needed. US-001 and US-003 can proceed independently; US-002 runs after US-001. Keep all created source/test paths repo-rooted in the PRD. The max-five context lists select the existing implementation and test exemplars; new outputs appear only in expectedFiles. Scope validation to package commands and targeted bun test paths; never use bare bun test or run coverage inside a sandboxed nax session. Regression baseline demonstrations are part of each story's test strategy, not separate quality-gate acceptance criteria. The spec's old/new signature baseline blocks are locator information only; implement the Target interfaces and the authoritative acceptance criteria.

Refine audit against the spec and re-read production/test context: all 26 numbered spec criteria are retained in their binding stories. US-001 mapping: 1 non-null oldest live load; 2a/2b all 50 live files and exactly one new failure archive; 3 image sidecar survival; 4a/4b 50-archive cap and oldest-archive deletion with explicit ordered mtimes; 5 unrelated live load; 6a/6b one deletion and both live documents preserved; 7a/7b default oldest-live deletion and count 1; 8 missing directory returns 0; 9a/9b below-cap count 0 and no deletion. US-002 mapping: 1 X still has a turn marker; 2 X sidecar remains; 3 subsequent X resume with the creation count unchanged (only Y's call), now kept together as one regression-anchored criterion; 4a/4b one Y fallback creation and Codex fresh-session notice. US-003 mapping: 1 informative tail past blanks; 2a/2b exact 12-line result and bounded byte total; 3 intact lines spanning a chunk; 4 intact UTF-8 character spanning a chunk; 5 CRLF result; 6 explicit raw tail control; 7 default 40-line control; 8 two-blank-line control; 9a/9b/9c zero limit, infinity and missing-file controls; 10 nonEmpty runner result; 11 real-runner panel tail; 12 exact three-argument call with its existing-test qualification; 13a/13b unchanged EACCES rejection and empty panel projection. All assertions are observable via returned data, exception identity, mock calls, byte counts or filesystem state. Negative paths already exist in every story: US-001 nonexistent-directory pruning, US-002 AGENT_SESSION_NOT_FOUND fallback, and US-003 missing/EACCES log reads; no unrelated failure feature is added. All three failure-table rows are covered, including both size and range error propagation and panel suppression. No description contradicts these criteria. All eight feature-level out-of-scope items remain verbatim, with the nearby panel-spec manual-edit boundary also echoed in US-003's scope. Context lists already include every spec-recommended context file and no story-created output; all binding workdirs/dependencies are unchanged. US-001/US-002 retain mandatory session-security test isolation; US-003 is reduced to medium/tdd-simple because its fully specified local helper/delegation uses standard filesystem seams and existing test fixtures rather than introducing a subsystem. Re-read locations confirming these decisions include transcript-store.ts:85/:212, open-chat-session.ts:248, acp-session-options.ts:35, job-runner.ts:533, job-panel-view.ts:174, job-runner-attach.test.ts:212 and job-panel-view.test.ts:426.
outOfScope: Findings 1, 3-12 of review e684f920 belong to the other three review-e684 features (acp-sessions, workflow-verification, pi-client).
Revising `.nax/features/chat-job-panel/spec.md` so its `readJobPanelView` paragraph names the `nonEmpty` read is a manual edit made with this spec; no story edits `.nax/`.
`sweepFeatureTranscripts` keeps pruning live and archived names together at feature startup; its contract is unchanged.
Archives already pruned by an earlier `retainFailed` are not recovered, and live documents deleted by an earlier failed resume are not recreated.
US-003 only: the background-task log reader `readLogTail` in `task-registry.ts` keeps its byte-bounded behaviour.
US-003 only: a `nonEmpty` read of a log that holds fewer qualifying lines than asked scans back to the start of the file; no byte cap is added for that case.
US-003 only: the panel refresh cadence (`JOB_PANEL_REFRESH_MS`) is unchanged.
US-003 only: a log line longer than the whole file's remaining bytes is returned whole, however long; no per-line length cap is added.
